title: S2-B3 continuous-interaction preflight supplement 1
decision: Freeze SW10_S2_B3_CONTINUOUS_PREFLIGHT_V1_SUPPLEMENT_1 prospectively. Supersede only two conflicting design fields in the original continuous-preflight decision: use same-date cross-sectional percentile ranks centered to [-1,+1], not winsorized z-scores; and assess feasibility independently for each of the eight preregistered interactions rather than requiring all eight to pass as a bundle. All other outcome-blindness, causal-factor, interaction, diagnostic, artifact, governance and cost restrictions remain unchanged.
evidence: MWE-SW10-S2B3P-001 COMPLETE/VERIFIED with NEITHER_FEASIBLE; no B3 outcomes inspected. Original continuous-preflight MWE exists but is ACTIVE / NOT EXECUTING, so this prospective supplement is frozen before implementation/execution.
rationale: The canonical thread explicitly approved centered percentile-rank normalization and interaction-by-interaction feasibility after the discrete preflight showed severe cell fragmentation. This preserves information without relaxing the failed discrete screen or selecting specifications from outcomes.

metadata_json.pass_rule: Each of the eight preregistered interactions receives FEASIBLE or NOT_FEASIBLE independently. No requirement that all eight pass. No alternate normalization or interaction search.

normalization.method: same-date cross-sectional percentile rank using average ranks for ties, mapped as 2*pct_rank-1 to [-1,+1]
normalization.fail_closed: insufficient eligible cross-section, undefined ranks, or zero interaction variation is ineligible and reported
normalization.interaction: product of centered percentile-rank primary and conditioner
